question.problem: Find the common ratio of the geometric sequence whose fourth term is $8$ and whose seventh term is $216.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the common ratio $r$ of a geometric sequence given two terms ${a}_{m}$ and ${a}_{n},$ we use the formula

$$
{r}^{n-m}=\frac{{a}_{n}}{{a}_{m}}.
$$

In this case, we're given ${a}_{7}=216$ and ${a}_{4}=8.$ Substituting $n=7$ and $m=4$ into the formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{7-4} & =\frac{{a}_{7}}{{a}_{4}} \\ {r}^{3} & =\frac{216}{8} \\ {r}^{3} & =27.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, by solving the equation for $r,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{3} & =27 \\ {r}^{3} & ={3}^{3} \\ r & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
